To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the clustered wavelet transform technique is a very effective tool in the classification of ultrasonics NDE signals.
the clustering of wavelet coefficients is a powerful feature extraction technique for the classification of signals from ultrasonic NDE of boiling water reactor pipe welds.

the DWT-based feature extraction technique is the most effective one for the classification of the NDE signals, while the DWT-based technique that exploits the clustering of the wavelet coefficients is the most effective of all.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development of a reliable ultrasonic signal classifier, and with the assessment of the effectiveness of the DWT clustering feature extraction technique with respect to the DGT and the DWT feature extraction techniques.
the development and evaluation of feature extraction techniques for ultrasonics signals acquired from the inspection of piping in nuclear power plants, in order to classify the defects found.
the application of artificial neural networks to the ultrasonic NDE problem.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the clustering of the wavelet coefficients provides an effective and efficient method for the feature extraction from ultrasonic signals.
the DWT method, when combined with a clustering procedure, is able to extract features that can be used for the classification of the ultrasonic signals with a good level of accuracy.
DWT-based techniques, and in particular the clustered DWT technique, are the most suitable for ultrasonic NDE signal classification, as demonstrated by the results presented here.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the DWT technique with clustered coefficients is more effective than DGT and DGT with respect to the classification of the NDE signals, while the DWT technique is more effective than the DWT technique.
the clustering of the wavelet coefficients is a useful technique for the extraction of relevant features for the classification of NDE signals.
the DWT method, when combined with clustering of the wavelet coefficients, is a good candidate to be used in ultrasonic NDE signal classification.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the clustering of the wavelet coefficients, in the wavelet domain, can be a powerful feature extraction technique for ultrasonic NDE signal classification, and that it can lead to a more robust and accurate classification of ultrasonic signals.

a clustering of wavelet coefficients, obtained using a simple k-means algorithm, is able to extract features that can be successfully used by artificial neural networks to perform a classification of the ultrasonic signals.
, for the considered application, DWT is more effective than DGT in terms of the accuracy of the classification system.
